pages.text: Link the RH-5 to a power network with the Conduit Binder. No fuel, oxygen or Thermal Core is needed.

pages.title: Heat on Demand
pages.text: Each RH-5 starts with a 5 kW power limit. Its slider adjusts that limit from 0 (off) to 50 kW. Higher limits warm cold rooms faster, but need proportionally more power. It still draws only the heat needed for 20°C or the room thermostat target. The screen distinguishes air and structure temperature.

pages.title: Backup and Brownouts
pages.text: Electrical heat runs before fuel heaters in the same modeled room; fuel covers any shortfall. PIXIE oxygen has priority over the heater. Lights and furnaces wait before heat does. A battery bank or isolated Cell Dock can keep it running until its cells drain. In vacuum, only 25% of paid heat couples into the structure. Insulation reduces steady demand.

pages.title: Rapid Heating
pages.text: At Default settings, a Diamond Thermal Heater with its capacitor produces about 12 kW of heat. A fully supplied RH-5 at 50 kW delivers about 4.2 times that output.$(br2)A full 500 kJ cell lasts only 10 seconds at continuous 50 kW; four full cells last 40 seconds. The slider setting survives saving. Power limited means the grid cannot supply the requested heat.
